title: This GitHub Tool Draws Your Story Illustrations Into a Video
description:
POV: you have 8 story illustrations but zero editing skills 😅 Someone put a free tool on GitHub that turns 7-9 pics into a 40sec vertical clip for Reels and TikTok. The best bit: the outline draws itself on screen, then it fills in with color like a real artist is sketching live ✨🔥 Runs through an agent, just tell it make a video. Its called handdraw story video.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
